records.text: Sorcerer skill points: Flame Arrow, Ice Chain and Firestorm first, then Blaze, Bittercold Wind, Hellfire, Winter's Shackles and Robe of Flame, all to 10 (Metabot, daevaguides, aion2turkiye; mmo-codex takes the first five to 8; Ice Chain, Winter's Shackles and Robe of Flame: Metabot and daevaguides). Flame Arrow, Ice Chain and Firestorm as the first points and Hellfire from when it is learned are two-source; the order between those rules is inferred.
Fire Mark on every Fire hit: Korea's 16 Sep patch, likely in your client (Metabot's skill text, mmo-codex, daevaguides); not checked in game.
Fire Mark to 10: Metabot's leveling build (aion2turkiye stops at 5).

First Daevanion nodes (Nezekan's Fire Mark and Robe of Earth pairs, then Zikel's Grace of Enhancement pair): Metabot's Nezekan nodes from its Sorcerer page, ordered by when the boards open; daevaguides and aion2turkiye take Nezekan's Combat Speed, Cooldown Reduction and Hellfire, Firestorm and Bittercold Wind nodes first.

Sorcerer learn levels (Bittercold Wind 3, Blaze 4, Flame Scattershot 5, Frost Burst 10, Hellfire 14 and the rest): your Sorcerer skill window, Metabot's skill pages (game data) and mmo-codex's unlock table.

Blaze's Lv 8 pick HP absorb (aion2turkiye, daevaguides solo; mmo-codex takes Delayed Damage) and Bittercold Wind's pull (aion2turkiye, daevaguides, mmo-codex's levelling text; its point list takes +1 s).
The leveling loop and holding Hellfire to charge it (Metabot's leveling build, mmo-codex, daevaguides; the charge levels are Hellfire's skill text).

Wish of Concentration to 7 (Metabot; aion2turkiye and daevaguides take it to 10) and Frost to 5 (Metabot; aion2turkiye spends nothing on it): the guide takes 7 and 5 with the last spare points. Spare points from quests and Sealed Dungeons go to Wish of Concentration first.
Specialty picks at skill Lv 8: Flame Arrow +20% MP restored, Firestorm −50% MP Cost, Hellfire +30% Skill Speed, Winter's Shackles damage boost (mmo-codex, aion2turkiye, daevaguides).
Stat priority (Attack, Critical Hit, MP): Metabot's Sorcerer page and class-builds guide (one site).

Stigmas Element Enhancement, Delayed Explosion, Fire Wall, Cold Storm (Metabot, mmo-codex). Element Enhancement first is in every source; daevaguides (solo) and aion2turkiye take Steel Barrier instead of Delayed Explosion and put Fire Wall in slot 2, so the fourth stigma and the slot order are Metabot's. Raised to 8 / 7 / 5 / 4: Metabot's.
Stigma slots 22 / 27 / 32 / 37; every stigma learnable at 22; shard cost per level (Metabot, allthings.how).
Blaze, Flame Scattershot and Frost Burst fire only on their conditions (Metabot's skill pages, game data; mmo-codex, daevaguides).
